identification: Rustic upholstered stool with storage compartment, H42 L63 D44 cm. Three photos: old dark-stained (near black) timber box on a plain base with a single side-hinged panelled door and small knob, door off in photo 3 showing an open timber-lined compartment, top padded with a fern-print hessian/tapestry style fabric. Probably a repurposed old cupboard, commode or cabinet cut down as a footstool/ottoman. Worn, scuffed finish, no maker's mark seen.

entries.note: Artiss new velvet storage ottoman blanket box, not similar to this old stained cupboard stool
